description: List named research facilities running active US clinical trials in a city, ranked by trial count. Returns each facility's name, ZIP, the top conditions they study, and one example NCT ID for quick verification. Use this when the caller asks where studies are happening in a specific city, or wants to surface named local clinics for a downstream clinicaltrials_search_trials call with the facility filter.

city.description: US city name. Allows letters, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes, and periods. Examples: "San Francisco", "St. Louis", "O'Fallon", "Wilkes-Barre". Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; maximum 100 characters.

limit.description: Maximum number of buckets to return from a top-N aggregation. Integer in [1, 25]. Default 10. Aggregator returns buckets sorted by descending count.

state.description: Two-letter US state code (e.g. CA, NY, TX, FL). Case-insensitive on input; normalized to uppercase. DC is accepted. Full state names like 'California' are not accepted - use 'CA' instead.

name: clinicaltrials_list_top_facilities

facilities.description: Facilities sorted by descending trial count.

exampleNctId.description: Canonical NCT id of one trial running at this facility. Pass to clinicaltrials_get_trial for the full record.

name.description: Facility name as recorded in AACT facilities.name.

topConditions.description: Most common condition labels for trials at this facility, sourced from AACT aggregations.

trialCount.description: Number of active US trials running at this facility within the scoped city.

zip.description: US ZIP code from the most common facility record, or null when absent.

scope.description: Echo of the resolved scope so the caller can confirm what the server interpreted.

city.description: Canonical city name resolved from the slug, present when city scope was used.

state.description: Canonical state code applied to this search.

title: List Top Facilities
